name: CFF Fluid Control Ltd
tagline: Niche Khopoli-based defence SME making fluid-control/piping systems and sonar-partnership equipment for Indian Navy submarines (Scorpene, P75I pipeline) - FY26 revenue +43% and PAT +64%, Rs 551 Cr order book (~2.6x revenue), mainboard migration approved and steady CFO insider buying, but ~53x trailing PAT with chronically negative (though modest) operating cash flow on tender-billing working capital
business_overview: Incorporated 2012, CFF Fluid Control manufactures and services shipboard machinery - critical fluid-control component systems and test facilities for submarines and surface ships for the Indian Navy, plus mechanical equipment/systems for nuclear and clean-energy industries. Facility at Khopoli (~6,000 sqm). Promoters/group have 20+ years in defence manufacturing; the company was set up specifically to serve MDL's Scorpene submarine programme. Partnered with Atlas Elektronik (TKMS subsidiary) - positions it in the supply chain for the ~$8-10bn Project-75I (6 additional submarines) alongside existing P75/Kalvari-class refit and surface-combatant (P17A, P15B, ASW corvette) work. Listed on BSE SME June 2023 (IPO Rs 165, Rs 85.8 Cr); FPO July 2026 at Rs 585 raised ~Rs 88 Cr; shareholders approved SME-to-mainboard (BSE/NSE) migration at the 14th AGM (7-Aug-2026). Source: external-lead, @ankitbahuguna84, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04.
fundamentals_table: Rs 209 Cr (+43% YoY) / Rs 39 Cr (+64% YoY, ~18.8% PAT margin)
Rs 551 Cr (>90% defence PSUs), ~2.6x FY26 revenue, delivery visibility to ~FY27
Chronically negative but modest: FY24 -Rs 27 Cr, FY25 -Rs 3 Cr, FY26 -Rs 26 Cr - tender/milestone-billing working-capital drag, not a blow-out (prior read's -Rs 260 Cr figure was an error)
~53x trailing P/E, ~7.8x P/B - rich for a defence SME, prices in much of the near-term growth
fundamentals_narrative: Real, live inflection: FY26 revenue +43% and PAT +64% with margin expansion to ~18.8% PAT (28% operating), a Rs 551 Cr order book (2.6x revenue, >90% defence PSUs) across submarine refit (HDW SSK, Kalvari P75), surface combatants and sonar systems, plus a fresh P75I opportunity (6 more submarines, ~7yr horizon, CFF partnered via Atlas Elektronik/TKMS). Recent Rs 78.74 Cr Indian Navy order (delivery by Apr-2027). CFO has been steadily buying in the open market since Dec 2025 - a genuine insider-conviction signal. Mainboard migration approved at the Aug-2026 AGM (liquidity/visibility catalyst) and a Rs 88 Cr FPO (Jul-2026, Rs 585) topped up cash for execution. Against this: operating cash flow has been negative every year (FY24 -27, FY25 -3, FY26 -26 Rs Cr) on advances/receivables build - a structural feature of milestone-billed defence projects, a real drag but far smaller than the prior read's -Rs 260 Cr (which was a transcription error). The stock trades at ~53x trailing PAT and ~7.8x book, pricing in much of the near-term growth. Half-yearly-only reporting (SME) means limited quarter-by-quarter visibility.
technical_read: Not pulled (not escalated - decent Tier-A candidate but valuation already rich; WebSearch fundamentals sufficed for the four-box read).

Community closely tracks order flow (P75/P75I, Cochin Shipyard, GRSE orders), CFO's open-market buying (tracked post-by-post since Dec 2025), the FY26 annual-report orderbook disclosure, and now the mainboard migration. Some skepticism on management opacity (no proactive investor communication; "management just don't reply") and richness of valuation.

CFO has disclosed open-market share purchases since Dec 2025. Mainboard migration approved 7-Aug-2026 AGM; small dividend declared. FPO closed Jul-2026 (~Rs 88 Cr at Rs 585).
bull_case: Live inflection, not a hoped-for one: FY26 revenue +43%, PAT +64%, margin expansion; FY24->FY26 revenue nearly doubled
Rs 551 Cr order book (2.6x FY26 revenue, >90% defence PSUs) with delivery visibility to FY27 across multiple naval programmes
P75I (~$8-10bn, 6 submarines) is a genuine multi-year pipeline; CFF already in the TKMS/Atlas Elektronik supply chain
CFO has bought steadily in the open market since Dec 2025 - real insider skin in the game
Near debt-free; mainboard migration approved (liquidity/visibility catalyst); FPO cash for execution
bear_case: ~53x trailing PAT and ~7.8x book - much of the near-term growth looks priced in
Operating cash flow negative every year (FY24 -27, FY25 -3, FY26 -26 Rs Cr) on advances/receivables - structural to milestone billing but a persistent drag; needs to inflect as deliveries complete
Management does not proactively communicate (no con-calls, doesn't respond to forum queries) - low information flow for an order-timing-dependent story; SME half-yearly reporting only
P75I award timing itself is not finalised (expected ~FY27) - concentrated programme dependency
Small-cap / recently-SME liquidity and defence-sector order lumpiness; promoter stake down ~5pp over 3y on IPO/FPO dilution
verdict_headline: Deep-dive pass 1: genuine live inflection (43%/64% growth, Rs 551 Cr order book, mainboard migration approved, steady CFO buying) in a real P75I-adjacent defence niche; four-box stays 2.0 on rich valuation - label held only via the growth-exception carve-out, conviction Medium with an unconfirmed caveat pending the OCF inflection and P75I award. The prior read's -Rs 260 Cr OCF figure was an error (actual FY26 -Rs 26 Cr).
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind yes (India naval indigenisation + P75I multi-year pipeline), tam weak (niche programme-dependent revenue base, though the Rs 551 Cr book gives real near-term headroom), moat weak (genuine defence-qualification barrier but concentrated on a handful of programmes/partners and one facility), valuation no (~53x trailing PAT / ~7.8x book is rich for an SME) -> score 2.0.

Score 2.0-2.5 band normally forces 'neither' unless an exception is written: growth here is genuinely un-ignorable (43%/64% YoY, live not projected; revenue nearly doubled FY24->FY26) -> exception invoked, thesis_fit '10x-in-2-3-years' allowed but conviction capped at Medium with an unconfirmed caveat per the decision table.
Correction vs prior read: FY26 operating cash flow was -Rs 26 Cr (screener.in), not -Rs 260 Cr - the working-capital drag is real and chronic but modest, which slightly de-risks the bear case.
No red flag. Source is untrusted external-lead (X triage) - no conviction floor applies.
Re-check trigger: operating cash flow turning positive as milestone billing catches up, and the P75I award / CFF's specific role in it becoming concrete.
